verdict_word: Beat on EPS and sales, 2027 guide out
takeaways: Adjusted EPS of $12.44 topped the $12.21 estimate (Benzinga) and Zacks' $12.15 (AP); sales of $2.988 billion beat about $2.94-2.95 billion.
Sales rose 23%, with 14% organic growth; the rest came from acquisitions such as Prince & Izant (about $1.07 billion, closed Sept. 28).
Net income fell 4% to $586 million on higher interest expense from a bigger debt load and higher taxes.
EBITDA As Defined margin was 53.0%, including about two points of dilution from recent deals, vs 54.2% a year ago.
First fiscal 2027 outlook: sales of $11.95-12.15 billion and adjusted EPS of $47.09-47.94. The company bought back $943 million of stock in the quarter.
verdict: TransDigm did the TransDigm thing: sell airplane parts at software margins, beat the number, buy another company, borrow more. Clean beat on profit and sales; the debt bill is the only thing that grew faster than the parts catalog.
